title: lambda 与 map/filter/sorted(key)
code:
nums = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9]
print(sorted(nums))
print(sorted(nums, key=lambda x: -x))
pairs = [("b", 2), ("a", 1), ("c", 3)]
print(sorted(pairs, key=lambda p: p[1]))
squares = list(map(lambda x: x * x, nums))
print(squares)
evens = list(filter(lambda x: x % 2 == 0, nums))
print(evens)
